t: Versatile Magnusson 6" wood/plastic double-sided jab saw with 7tpi designed for efficient cutting of wood and plastic materials. The heat-treated steel blade ensures durability and a long-lasting sharp edge, making it ideal for trade professionals tackling various tasks. The double-sided blade allows for easy manoeuvring, particularly useful when cutting plasterboard or working in confined spaces. Featuring 7 tpi durable hard-point teeth, the jab saw provides a coarse cut and operates effectively on both push and pull strokes, enhancing productivity. An ergonomic soft-grip handle offers excellent comfort and control during prolonged use, reducing hand fatigue.
